card.name: Digits inside numbers in data tables
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle or end of a multi-digit number, mostly inside tables of counts, percentages, doses and fractions such as 39/189 or 8 (24.2).

modes.label: Table cell digits
modes.description: A digit within a number in a row of table values with counts and percentages.

modes.label: Fraction or ratio digits
modes.description: A digit inside the numerator or denominator of a fraction or ratio.
